scientific_question: After the successful causal hidden-side correction, does a task-selected output-side residual correction capture materially more current Muon motion and held-out future phase motion than spending the identical coordinate budget on additional hidden-side stages?

prior_geometry_evidence.interpretation: Output-side correction is a plausible residual term, whereas nonuniform singular-value motion is too small to justify another gain/spectral structure.

causal_protocol.hidden: Select hidden-channel connectivity and closed-form angles from the exact current coherent Muon update.
causal_protocol.output: After applying the hidden correction, select output-channel connectivity and closed-form angles only from the remaining current requested-update residual.
causal_protocol.solver: one deployable closed-form diagonal Gauss-Seidel sweep, hidden then output; not an exact joint normal-equation oracle

scope.random_control: edge-disjoint task-independent one-factorized hidden/output matchings with the same coordinate count

decision_rule.pass: implement the task-selected bilateral folded-base optimizer and require exact state/resume tests plus a directly polled real-training MFU certificate of at least 20 percent before one new 124M run
decision_rule.fail: reject output-side correction as an inefficient use of coordinates; do not train it, and compare higher-capacity hidden-only task-selected charts under an exact coordinate/MFU gate

excluded_followups: per-channel or singular-value gain sweeps, because singular-value motion is less than one percent of dense c_proj phase energy and the earlier production bilateral chart already captured 94.93 percent of that small component
fixed random bilateral charts, already shown structurally misaligned
learned dense bases or LoRA-like adapters
any 124M language-model run before this no-training gate
execution_policy: Run directly in the foreground on one idle Y400 GPU and poll to exit. Do not use a watchdog, callback, queue worker, heartbeat, or PRO6.
